title: docs(qa): wave-2 checklist-accuracy close-out, slice A — seven areas and three RUNNER facts
body:
Part of #25807 (wave-2 accuracy, slice A)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按 18.2.0 第二波五份测试记录，修正 7 个领域共 37 条测试清单条目和 1 个共享配方里的过时描述，并给 RUNNER.md 补 3 条环境事实。只改文档，不动产品代码。
- 为什么改：第二波运行发现这些条目的步骤、字段名、错误码或引用的测试文件已与当前代码不符，下一轮运行会被误导、误判或白跑。
- 风险与回滚：只影响 QA 清单文本，不改任何断言的判定标准（新增的只有 trigger-status-contract 的第五行和 query-contract-matrix 的六个运算符变体）。每条 revision +1、追加一行 history，回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`areas/integration-system.json` 的 webhook-lifecycle（#23166 是已关闭的运行记录，不是阻塞卡）；`areas/automation.json` 的 trigger-status-contract（新增 422 FLOW_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID 行）；`RUNNER.md` 的三条新事实。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`，预期打印 `check-platform-checklist: OK`、退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The slice-A close-out of the wave-2 checklist-accuracy findings that RUNNER.md routes to the wave anchor ("close out through the wave's anchor card … not extracted"). Sources: anchor comments 6433587719, 6433708086, 6433784748, 6433878766, 6433966437 and the run records #26450, #26456, #26468, #26476, #26481. Every finding was checked against the code at base `e4ba846f` before its edit; the history row of each item names the file read.

- **37 items** in `automation`, `cli`, `api-backend`, `identity-auth`, `integration-system`, `search` and `ux-conventions`: `revision` +1 from main's value and one appended `history` row each, citing the run record that found it. No existing history row is touched.
- **1 shared recipe**: `search.json` `qa-contributor-bound-member` step 5 asks for a non-churned account (recipes carry no revision; its `provenance` line records the change).
- **RUNNER.md**: (1) a per-boot `-d` DB does not isolate the showcase's upload root or its external datasource file; (2) the process-kill hook refuses one command that runs `ps`, `grep` and a kill, so the group stop runs on its own; (3) the `OS_PORT`-connector entry now says `os dev` compiles by default since #26130.
- `automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract` changes `surface` from `api` to `mixed`: its acceptance[6] is a Studio browser leg.

### No change, and why

- `cli.migrate-plan-apply-json`: already corrected by #26795 (dispatch note).
- The api-backend items re-pinned the same day by #26572 (`declarative-endpoint-execution`, `packaged-action-disabled-dispatch`, `action-activation-door-contract`, `rest-crud-config-contract`, `rest-batch-config-contract`, `rest-metadata-config-contract`, `rest-route-generation-tombstones`, `second-object-exposure-and-internal-fields`, `data-request-shape-and-query-arity`, `meta-read-doors-v18`, `error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code`): each wave-2 line on them was read against the current text, which already names the pins and the layer each reaches (for example, `rest-crud-config-contract` says its discovery pin runs at `/objects`, and `rest-route-generation-tombstones` says §E's plugin-path case drives `batch.defaultAtomic`).
- Lines that read "ref accurate" (confirmations, nothing stale): `automation.durable-suspend-restart` (its ref already calls the fixture the pin's own), `paused-run-trigger-record-masked`, `flow-registration-verdict-on-read`, `flow-authoring-refusals-v18`, `flow-run-semantics-v18`, `inbound-hook-timestamped-signature`, `scheduled-work-opt-in`; `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`, `meta-package-flags-and-explain`, `validate-v18-authoring-verdicts`, `verify-derived-proof-families`; `cli.migrate-meta-write-stored-and-all` (a scoring divergence; its ref claims no command layer).
- `automation.packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal`: the run confirmed knownGaps[0] live, and its N1 fixture gap already has a recipe (#26622).
- `integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application`: its ref already names both pins the mapping cited.
- `identity-auth.two-factor-enrollment-reveal` and `two-factor-backup-codes`: the shared two-factor lines are applied where the items read rows or settings; backup-codes already names the DB-file read.
- The identity-auth (9) and search (3) items of #26450 carry clause verdicts only, no accuracy line.
- `cli.scaffold-first-run`'s revision-6 history row says 'seven clauses' for five: history rows are append-only, so it stays.
- Outside slice A, not touched: the v17 `--legacy-peer-deps` recipe line lives in `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` fixtures, and `studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle`'s METADATA_CONFLICT / NO_DRAFT lines belong to slice B.

## Acceptance notes

Observations from these records that are not ledger edits (reported to the seat, not filed here):

- `webhook-lifecycle` A2: whether a flow node's predicate multi-write should carry the organization is a maintainer question raised in #23166, and no open issue carries it (its successor anchors closed with it noted). The wave-2 run measured the block again.
- A retired-filter-operator refusal is cut at the 500-character client-message bound before the `$contains` alternative its prescription names (#26476; `truncateClientMessage`).
- The kanban drop gate's dimmed lane carries no reason text (#26456), against the disabled-control convention.
- After a failed datasource connect, `POST /api/v1/datasources/NAME/test` answers 'no registered driver to introspect', which names no cause (#26481).

## Verification

`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` exits 0 on the head. Run `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas` to see that each hunk is the item's text plus one new history row.
